# IConfigSection.RemoveByPrefix method

Removes every key in this section whose name begins with *prefix* (ordinal comparison). Use this to drop a whole group of related keys at once — e.g. all per-resolution sub-keys of one entry. Does NOT write to disk — caller must invoke [`Save`](./Save.md). Keys that don't match are left untouched; never throws.
